best_hooks: Slow feet don't lose you the rally. Landing your split step late does. (Djokovic, timing bar)
Short arms don't make you late. Hitting beside your body instead of in front does. (Alcaraz, top-down contact zone)
A weak serve doesn't lose you service games. Tossing it behind your head does. (Federer, toss line)
